# create-new-react-component

> React component generator CLI for creating JavaScript and TypeScript component folders with CSS Modules, SCSS Modules, custom templates, project defaults, and optional tests.

## Links

- Homepage: https://cnrc.zhengfu.me/
- GitHub: https://github.com/snowden-fu/create-new-react-component
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-new-react-component
- Documentation: https://github.com/snowden-fu/create-new-react-component#readme

## Install

```bash
npx create-new-react-component Button
```

```bash
npm install --save-dev create-new-react-component
```

## Common commands

```bash
create-new-react-component Button --lang ts --style scss --with-test
create-new-react-component Card --type forwardRef --with-props
create-new-react-component Badge --style none --dir src/components
```

## Features

- Interactive and non-interactive React component generation.
- JavaScript and TypeScript output.
- CSS Modules, SCSS Modules, or no generated style file.
- Functional, arrow function, class, memoized, and forwardRef templates.
- Optional generated component test files with `--with-test`.
- Project defaults from `.cnrc.json`.
- Custom template files with `--template` and `--template-dir`.
